description: curl PACKAGECONFIG flags that affect CVE applicability

ldap.notes: Disables LDAP/LDAPS protocol handler. LDAP-specific CVEs not applicable when protocol support removed.

ftp.notes: Disables FTP/FTPS protocol handler. FTP connection reuse and wildcard CVEs not applicable.

smtp.notes: Disables SMTP protocol handler. SMTP end-of-response OOB read and SMTP send heap buffer overflow not applicable.

imap.notes: Disables IMAP protocol handler. IMAP FETCH response out-of-bounds read not applicable.

pop3.notes: Disables POP3 protocol handler. No protocol-specific CVEs identified as of 2026-04.

tftp.notes: Disables TFTP protocol handler. TFTP small blocksize heap buffer overflow, receive buffer overflow, and packet overflow CVEs not applicable.

telnet.notes: Disables Telnet protocol handler. Telnet IAC injection CVE not applicable.

libssh2.notes: Disables SCP/SFTP via libssh2. Terrapin SSH attack not applicable through curl. Note: CVE is in the SSH protocol, suppression confidence is medium.

nghttp2.notes: Disables HTTP/2 support. HTTP/2 rapid reset and CONTINUATION frame CVEs not applicable. Note: some CVEs are in nghttp2, not curl itself.

proxy.notes: Disables proxy protocol support. Proxy-specific HSTS and path traversal CVEs not applicable.
